title: Apple Pie Pizza

ingredientGroups.title: Ingredients
items: 8 Macintosh apples, peeled, cored and chopped

steps: Roll or stretch the dough to ⅛–½ inch thick. Prepare the apple pie filling; the source does not provide a filling method.
Pre-bake the pizza base at 500–600°F for 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Spread mascarpone on the base, add the apple filling, dot with butter and sprinkle with cinnamon and brown sugar.
Return to the oven until the filling is crisp and bubbling. Rest briefly, slice and serve, optionally with vanilla ice cream.
reviewFlags: The source omits the apple filling preparation and brown sugar quantity and lists white sugar without specifying how to use it.
